title: LMDB: Send+Sync impl not compiler-verified
description: crates/lmdb/src/lib.rs: LmdbBlockDb is used across threads (Arc<LmdbBlockDb>) but there is no explicit impl Send + Sync or a static assertion to verify the compiler grants those impls. If a future change adds a !Send field (e.g., Rc, RefCell) the Send+Sync property would silently be lost. Fix: add a compile-time static assertion: const _: () = { fn assert_send_sync<T: Send + Sync>() {} assert_send_sync::<LmdbBlockDb>(); };
